# TreasuryOS (treasury-mcp-os)

> MCP server and Streamlit apps for small-business banking: cash position, forecasting, working capital, debt covenants, FX exposure, idle cash, payment timing, and credit / loan-readiness scoring. Python 3.11+, no API keys, runs on local CSV data.

## Docs
- [AGENTS.md](https://github.com/GPBK-STUY/treasury-mcp-os/blob/main/AGENTS.md): setup, run commands, MCP tool reference, data format, conventions
- [CLAUDE.md](https://github.com/GPBK-STUY/treasury-mcp-os/blob/main/CLAUDE.md): tool-chaining patterns and financial/credit guardrails
- [README.md](https://github.com/GPBK-STUY/treasury-mcp-os/blob/main/README.md): overview and live app links
- [QUICKSTART.md](https://github.com/GPBK-STUY/treasury-mcp-os/blob/main/QUICKSTART.md): Claude Desktop setup

## Code
- [server.py](https://github.com/GPBK-STUY/treasury-mcp-os/blob/main/server.py): MCP server, 9 tools, stdio or streamable HTTP
- [tools/](https://github.com/GPBK-STUY/treasury-mcp-os/tree/main/tools): analysis engine

## Live apps
- [Business owner loan readiness](https://treasury-mcp-os-hrxsrpycxbotvmejybhmvy.streamlit.app/)
- [RM dashboard](https://treasury-os-rm.streamlit.app/)
